name: social-connect-root
description: Social Connect — Fullstack App with React Frontend and MongoDB/Express Backend

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'backend', shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'myapp', shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.install:all: cd myapp && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
